_readme: Facts for the estimate spec line, keyed by series id. A field is present only when a file in this repo states it for that series. Omitted features are gaps (see _gaps) and must not be printed. Do not fill argon, warranty, or high-heat glazing bead from general knowledge. lifetimeWarranty is the customer phrase when a lifetime warranty is stated. glass is the package that comes with the series. types.<id>.glass overrides glass for that window or door type only.

_gaps.why: brochures/milgard-v250-style-line.pdf only says warm-edge spacers improve argon retention. tools/milgard_quote_lines.json lists Argon Gas Filled on some V250 quotes, not all. Not a standard feature.
No brochure or data file states a high-heat glazing bead. js/pages/milgard-ui.js says high heat bead where available.
Quotes mix SunCoat (Low-E) and Cardinal 340+. js/pages/milgard-ui.js says SunCoatMAX is included. Those disagree, so no package is printed.
The V250 brochure states Lifetime Limited Warranty only. It does not state Full Lifetime.
Same as V250. Argon Gas Filled is on some quotes in tools/milgard_quote_lines.json, not every V300 line. The brochure does not say the unit is argon-filled.
Not stated for V300. js/pages/milgard-ui.js says where available.
Quote glass is Cardinal 340+ (Low-E). The Milgard screen says SunCoatMAX. No single package is confirmed.

brochures/milgard-v300-trinsic.pdf says Full Lifetime is an optional upgrade for a fee. data/variable-rates.json says Glass Breakage + Full Lifetime is included in the fitted V300 rates. The two conflict, so Full Lifetime is left off. Lifetime limited warranty stays, from the brochure.
